text:
tara_cs: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth wants a compact enablement: 60m product walkthrough + 30m office hours next week. Need host, backup, and agenda. Prefer PST morning for U.S. team and a second session for EMEA. Thoughts? :calendar:

samir_enable: I can host the 60m walkthrough Wed 10:00am PST. Demo heavy, 45m demo + 15m Q&A. Will own slides. @lee_ops can you prep the Dedicated migration notes?

lee_ops: yup, I'll compile infra checklist and bring Dedicated + Private deployment notes. Can we include the KV cache tip and a brief quantization caveat?

mia_support: Add a billing/quotas slide and auth/KMS quickstart. Also capture step-by-step rollback in the notes. I'll own the follow-up doc.

miguel_rev: For EMEA attendees I can run a follow-up Thu 16:00 CET (convenient for APAC overlaps). Could be a condensed 45m session + 30m office hrs. :thumbsup:

bot_scheduler: Poll created — https://cal.poll/NovaHealth-enable (select preferred slots). Deadline Tue 12:00pm PST.

tara_cs: agenda draft (rough):
```
- 00:00-05:00 intro + goals
- 05:00-20:00 demo: onboarding flow + auth
- 20:00-40:00 scaling & routing policies (caching, batching)
- 40:00-50:00 Dedicated migration checklist
- 50:00-60:00 Q&A
- 60:00-90:00 optional office hours
```
Would like a slide owner for scaling section.

samir_enable: I'll own scaling section. Will include a quick perf chart and a 'when to use Dedicated' decision tree.

lee_ops: also add an ops-runbook snippet for immediate triage (logs + commands). I'll paste in thread later.

mia_support: recording + notes required. Who will send calendar invites and set guest permissions for NovaHealth team?

tara_cs: @bot_scheduler can you create invites once poll finishes? otherwise I'll send from CS calendar. Also we need to capture feedback form — 3 quick Qs about clarity, readiness to migrate, and remaining blockers.

miguel_rev: I can draft the feedback form. Suggest 1-2 follow-ups for renewal risk signals (e.g., blockers unresolved, timeline slip).

samir_enable: teams: @samir_enable, @lee_ops, @mia_support, @miguel_rev. Backup host: @tara_cs

tara_cs: perfect. action items:
- samir: slides + scaling section
- lee: infra checklist + runbook snippet
- mia: billing slide + follow-up doc
- miguel: EMEA session + feedback form
- tara/bot: finalize invites after poll
Will reconvene Wed 9:00am PST for a 15m dry run. /remind @channel 1 hour before dry run

lee_ops: :rocket: Added to calendar draft. I'll drop infra snippet in thread in 20m.

mia_support: FYI NovaHealth asked for a sample RBAC policy. I'll attach in follow-up doc.

bot_scheduler: Reminder set for Wed 8:00am PST for dry-run. Poll closes Tue 12:00pm PST.
